subject: SpectraAI marketplace activation: PO routing + EU VAT invoicing
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@spectra.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@spectra.ai
Date: 2028-08-11T16:12:00Z
Subject: Marketplace listing & PO process questions

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this — we (SpectraAI) are preparing to go live in the AWS + Azure marketplaces and are mapping procurement steps across regions, specifically EU invoicing and VAT treatment. A few quick questions to help our finance team: 

- How do purchase orders (POs) map into billing for each marketplace (direct purchase vs. reseller invoicing)?
- Do you require a SpectraAI PO before activation on AWS/Azure/GCP, or can you invoice after listing?
- Is there a standard PO template you can accept for marketplace channels?

We also have a list of documents the marketplaces have requested — happy to share. Goal is to avoid a last-minute billing hold when we flip the listing live.

Appreciate any clarity and a recommended next step.

Best,
Emily Park
Head of Procurement, SpectraAI
(Attachment: vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Emily Park <emily.park@spectra.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-08-11T18:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing & PO process questions

Hi Emily — thanks for the note. Quick answers upfront and then I'll loop in Finance for the PO specifics: 

- Marketplace billing varies by cloud: AWS Marketplace typically routes payment through the marketplace (customer is billed by AWS or through the marketplace contract) while Azure and GCP can offer both marketplace billing and direct invoicing depending on program enrollment.
- For Redwood-hosted listings we can accept a PO ahead of enablement and queue activation, but for marketplace-managed billing we usually need the seller onboarding completed plus any cloud-specific tax forms before entitlement is enabled.
- I'll attach the PO template we prefer and a high-level mapping matrix for PO->billing per cloud.

Next step: Ben from Finance will confirm the exact flow for EU VAT invoicing and any vendor-side paperwork required. Vanessa, can you help with the marketplace ops checklist and whether we should request cloud reseller IDs from Spectra prior to go-live?

Thanks — Olga
Olga Petrov
Manager, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: spectra_po_template.pdf)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-08-12T08:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing & PO process questions

Looping in Marketplace Ops details. Short checklist for Spectra: 

- Seller account IDs for each cloud (AWS Seller ID / Azure Publisher ID / GCP Partner ID)
- Completed tax forms (W-8/W-9 equivalents for non-US entities; EU VAT registration docs)
- Evidence bundle: SOC2 summary, contact for technical support, product SKU mapping
- Vendor onboarding PO — if they submit a PO we can stage entitlement but marketplace billing still requires cloud acceptance

I recommend asking Spectra to provide seller IDs and VAT registration early. On the ops side, once PO + evidence bundle arrive we can request marketplace activation slots (usually 3–5 business days after submission).

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2028-08-12T10:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing & PO process questions

Hi team — technical note from Finance on how POs and VAT should be handled for Spectra's EU customers: 

- AWS Marketplace (paid by AWS) — AWS collects payment and issues invoice to customer; Redwood receives consolidated payout from AWS. We do not need to invoice the end customer directly. Spectra should still provide VAT registration so AWS can process tax treatment correctly.
- Azure Marketplace (``Bring Your Own Billing`` vs CSP/reseller) — if using Azure Marketplace transactable offers, Microsoft handles billing; if using CSP/reseller flows, Spectra may need to accept purchase orders with monthly invoicing.
- GCP Marketplace — similar to AWS when transactable; direct invoicing options exist under negotiated contracts.

PO guidance: We can accept Spectra's PO prior to enablement and create an internal ticket to hold activation. However, the PO must match the seller name on their marketplace enrollment and include the cloud SKU mapping. I've attached a PO template and a matrix mapping purchase order -> billing path per cloud.

VAT specifics for EU: Spectra must provide their VAT ID for each EU country they operate in (or a single EU VAT ID if applicable). For marketplace transactions handled by the cloud provider, the provider will follow reverse-charge rules where applicable — but we should collect VAT IDs to validate the customer's tax treatment. If Spectra expects Redwood to issue invoices directly in EU, we need to set up local invoicing (extra 2–3 weeks) and confirm tax representation.

(Attachments: purchase_flow_matrix.xlsx, eu_vat_instructions.docx)

—Ben Carter
Director, Finance Operations

2) We prefer to send our standard PO for the initial listing. Is the attached template acceptable, or do you need us to use Redwood's template?
3) Estimated lead time: once we submit seller IDs, PO, and evidence bundle, when can we realistically expect live status in AWS and Azure?

If easier, we can set a short call tomorrow to walk through the paper trail.

Emily

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Emily Park <emily.park@spectra.ai>, olga_petrov@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2028-08-14T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing & PO process questions

Emily — quick answers and an action plan: 

- Aggregated invoicing: For AWS/Azure transactable offers, aggregated invoicing via the cloud provider is generally sufficient and preferred — this avoids extra local invoicing work. We will only require direct invoicing if Spectra explicitly requests Redwood-managed invoicing for specific customers or territories.
- PO template: Your standard PO is fine if the seller name and SKU mappings are present. We prefer using the attached spectra_po_template.pdf for internal intake (we'll accept their PO and map fields).
- Lead time: Once we have seller IDs + PO + evidence bundle, ops lead time is typically 3–7 business days for AWS and 5–10 business days for Azure (depends on review queues). GCP timelines are similar to AWS.

Action items:
- Spectra to upload seller IDs, VAT docs and their standard PO to our shared drive link (see related links).
- Ben to confirm whether any EU-specific invoicing setup is required if Spectra requests Redwood invoices (Ben: can you confirm approximate SLA and admin steps?).
- Vanessa to open marketplace activation tickets once documents are in place.

I've created a HubSpot record for the onboarding (SPC-2028-0811) and added the procurement checklist.

Jonas Weber
Marketplace Enablement Lead
Redwood Inference
